pr_title: Idea is somewhat simple: monotone functions over integers ARE invertible

labels.summary: The monotone preimage rule could rewrite filters over date/time functions using infinity sentinels, which can make the function return NULL for non-NULL inputs and drop rows incorrectly; the fix skips the rewrite when infinity is present and the rule is not applied at a root filter.

not_strict_because: no failing fix-added case (fix-modified file only)
